extracted.intended_audience: producers, editors, and engineers preparing programs for PBS broadcast
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and technical requirements for producers to create, package, and deliver programs accepted for broadcast by the PBS National Program Service and Plus Service. Includes required technical specs, delivery procedures, and ancillary promotional/digital guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: PBS Producer's Handbook — follow and share
rubrics_metrics.description: The PBS Producer’s Handbook is designed to help producers create and deliver content for PBS; it provides detailed information on a wide range of producer responsibilities and requirements, including production and promotional deliverables, broadcast standards and practices and general policies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Producers are encouraged to read the Handbook and share it with their production teams. Use it as the primary reference for production responsibilities and PBS policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not initiate packaging/delivery before final approval
rubrics_metrics.description: Producers who have submitted programs to PBS but have not yet received final approval should not initiate the packaging and delivery process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait for final acceptance/approval from PBS National Program Service or Plus Service before beginning packaging/delivery to avoid wasted effort or noncompliant submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meet Technical Operating Specifications (TOS)
rubrics_metrics.description: All programs must meet the technical requirements set forth in PBS's Technical Operating Specifications (TOS) Manual.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure audio/video formats, codecs, signal levels, metadata, and other technical parameters conform to the TOS. The TOS is the authoritative technical spec for broadcast eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the TOS Submission documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: TOS Submission (document) is intended for producers, editors and engineers who are submitting programs for PBS broadcast.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the TOS Submission guidance when preparing deliverables for ingestion; it contains submission-specific instructions and requirements for personnel involved in delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference the TOS Short Form when applicable
rubrics_metrics.description: A TOS Short Form (condensed version) is available as an additional, shorter technical reference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the short form for quick checks or where a concise summary of TOS requirements is sufficient, but defer to the full TOS for authoritative rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Observe PBS Safe Areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow the PBS Safe Areas document for on-screen safe-area guidelines (margins for titles/graphics).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design graphics and on-screen text to remain inside PBS safe areas so essential content is not cropped on different displays or transmission paths.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Satellite Uplinks and Distribution procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Satellite Uplinks and Distribution documents may be referenced as applicable for delivery over satellite and for distribution procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult these documents when your program will be transmitted via satellite or when specific distribution workflows apply; they contain operational and technical delivery steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adhere to Additional Guidelines (digital sponsorship, sites, promos, photography, standards)
rubrics_metrics.description: Supplementary guidance exists for digital sponsorship, building a PBS.org site, on-air announcements promoting program-related goods and services, photography, and PBS Standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the appropriate additional guideline for non-broadcast or ancillary materials (website builds, sponsorship messaging, photographic assets, promotional announcements) to ensure compliance with PBS policies and brand standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Programs must pass automated QC (Interra Systems Baton) per PBS test plan
rubrics_metrics.description: PBS performs automated QC on all incoming programs using Interra Systems Baton; producers should use the latest PBS test plan for Baton.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Download and validate deliverables against the latest PBS Baton test plan prior to submission to reduce rejections. Automated QC checks will be applied by PBS upon ingest.
